field_contract.raw_deadline_source: R60 same-scene lifecycle detection timestamp + deadline_offset
field_contract.remaining_time_formula: deadline - (decision_step - 1); R30 clock audit verified now=step-1
field_contract.missing_policy: missing values stay null and are excluded from remaining-time ranges; never imputed as zero
